name: Furious Tribes
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Instinctive
specialRules.description: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Mend
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Savage
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Savage Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Savage. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Fighter
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Speed Feat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Speed Feat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Savage
specialRules.description: If this model has Savage, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Savage (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Takedown Strike
specialRules.description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

specialRules.name: Pierce
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Counter-Attack
specialRules.description: May strike first when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Evasion. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Shooting Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Brutal
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies that already finished an activation this round, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Brutal
specialRules.description: If this model has Brutal, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Brutal (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Quick
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Speed Feat
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this unit moves, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it move +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Takedown
specialRules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3” of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it
